roleTitle: User Research Operations Specialist, Credit Workflow System
jobDescription: The credit workflow system at a commercial bank is used by underwriters and relationship managers. The User Research Operations Specialist owns the research operations programme end-to-end: recruits participants from the bank's staff, holds the sign-off on research plans for compliance, leads the quarterly research planning session, and is accountable to the head of product design for research quality and consent records. The programme supports three product designers and two researchers, and the role works with the compliance office and the business units that lend their underwriters and relationship managers to research sessions.
requirements: Owns the research operations programme end-to-end and holds the compliance sign-off on research plans.
Recruits participants from bank staff and maintains the participant and consent records.
Leads the quarterly research planning session with product design and records decisions.
Coordinates research logistics with compliance and the business units and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents known limitations and hand-over conditions for each research round.

evidence.text: Owned the research operations programme for the credit workflow product for two years as the named programme owner, holding the compliance sign-off on each research plan under the delegation recorded with the compliance office.
Recruited underwriters and relationship managers as participants through the business units and maintained the participant and consent records in the research repository.
Led the quarterly research planning session with the product design team, deciding the research calendar and recording the decisions in the planning notes.
Coordinated research logistics with compliance and the business units, recording that the business units owned participant availability while I owned scheduling, consent and the plan sign-off.
Responsibilities included programme ownership, plan sign-off, participant recruitment, consent records and the quarterly planning session over about two years.

Work sample: the compliance delegation record naming the candidate for research-plan sign-off, one signed research plan and the planning notes for one quarter, with the research repository's record identifiers as a verification trail.
Reference call with the former head of product design: confirmed the candidate owned the programme, held the compliance sign-off delegation and led the planning sessions; confirmed employment dates.
Recruiter logistics note: candidate can present the research operations process on site; notice period is one month.
